At Databricks, we are obsessed with enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions.
  
  
Our mission at Databricks is to radically simplify the whole data lifecycle from ingestion to ETL, BI, and all the way up to ML/AI with a unified platform. The new architecture will help address several major challenges, including data staleness, reliability, total cost of ownership, data lock-in, and limited use-case support.

* Query compilation and optimization
* Distributed query execution and scheduling
* Vectorized execution engine
* Data security
* Resource management
* Transaction coordination
* Efficient storage structures (encodings, indexes)
* Automatic physical data optimization
* Data plane storage
* Storage management system

As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own the Natural Language Inference (NLI) model at the center of our compliance engine: fine-tuning, calibrating, and monitoring it in production. You will also design the science behind framework decomposition, evidence auto-linking, and a new agent-context system that tackles retrieval, grounding, and hallucination measurement for AI agents. Your work will directly shape the accuracy and trustworthiness of every customer-visible result we produce.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the production NLI model end-to-end: fine-tune, promote, calibrate thresholds, and monitor for drift to ensure accurate compliance verdicts across frameworks.
* Design and implement framework decomposition pipelines that translate compliance controls into NLI hypotheses, including enrichment and per-framework threshold calibration.
* Build and improve the evidence auto-linking system using ranking, embedding, and reranking techniques, tuning precision-recall tradeoffs and addressing OCR quality challenges.
* Drive the quality flywheel by establishing labeling standards, designing offline and online evaluation methods, orchestrating retraining cycles, and ensuring privacy-safe data handling.
* Research and develop the agent-context capability — retrieval and representation of lifecycle signals, cross-framework knowledge, memory, grounding, and hallucination measurement — collaborating with engineering pods to bring these models into production.

A day in the life
  
  
You will split your time between collaborative and heads-down work. On the collaborative side, you will partner with several pods of software development engineers in an Agile cadence — aligning on data collection needs, sharing experiment results, and integrating models into production services. On the heads-down side, you will dig into model training runs, analyze evaluation metrics, and iterate on threshold tuning until the numbers meet the bar. At the SEI AI Division, we conduct research in applied artificial intelligence and the engineering questions related to the practical design and implementation of AI technologies and systems. We currently lead a community-wide movement to mature the discipline of AI Engineering for Defense and National Security.

As our government customers adopt AI and machine learning to provide leap-ahead mission capabilities, we

* build real-world, mission-scale AI capabilities through solving practical engineering problems
* discover and define the processes, practices, and tools to support operationalizing AI for robust, secure, scalable, and human-centered mission capabilities
* prepare our customers to be ready for the unique challenges of adopting, deploying, using, and maintaining AI capabilities
* identify and investigate emerging AI and AI-adjacent technologies that are rapidly transforming the technology landscape

Are you creative, curious, energetic, collaborative, technology-focused, and hard-working? Are you interested in making a difference by bringing innovation to government organizations and beyond? Apply to join our team.

**Overview:**
As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will specialize in engineering solutions that support research into the vulnerabilities of AI and ML algorithms and securing against those vulnerabilities.

The Secure AI Lab within the SEI’s AI Division focuses on improving the security and robustness of AI systems. As part of the world-class research community at Carnegie Mellon University, the Secure AI Lab conducts and applies cutting-edge research to protect AI systems from adversaries who aim to manipulate the system to learn, do, or reveal something it isn’t supposed to.

The Secure AI Lab consists of machine learning research scientists, machine learning engineers, and software developers who work together to solve problems in the following areas:

* **Counter AI Research:**
  Study threat models targeting AI and ML algorithms, understand the behaviors of AI algorithms, identify weak points, and design novel ways to subvert AI and ML systems.
* **AI and ML Algorithm Defense Research:**
  Create practical mitigations and defenses for observed attacks affecting AI and ML algorithms and evaluate the effectiveness of defensive techniques.
* **Applied Adversarial Machine Learning:**
  Advance the state of the art in adversarial machine learning by developing and transitioning capabilities to government sponsors.

As an engineer, you will solve problems for government sponsors by analyzing, designing, and building responsible AI systems.

Your day-to-day engineering tasks will include:

* **Identifying and investigating**
  emerging AI and AI-adjacent technologies.
* **Defining and refining**
  processes, practices, and tools for working with AI.
* **Designing and building**
  well-engineered prototypes of AI systems.
* **Transitioning and providing**
  guidance on
  AI capabilities to government sponsors.

**Duties**

* **Building Machine Learning Models and Systems:**
  You will work with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Torch, and Caffe and modern programming languages including Python, C/C++, and Java. You will build and work with data pipelines, ETL processes, and backend systems. You will work with, extend, and implement state-of-the-art machine learning methods.
* **Technical Experimentation:**
  You will experiment with modern and emerging machine learning frameworks, methods, and algorithms in application domains that include computer vision, natural language processing, planning and scheduling, robot control, and engineering safe, trusted, and reliable machine learning systems.
* **Testing and evaluation.**
  You'll conduct rapid prototyping to demonstrate and evaluate technologies in relevant environments. You'll evaluate systems for performance and security. You'll test capabilities using novel testing and analysis techniques.
* **Collaboration.**
  You'll actively participate on teams of developers, researchers, designers, and technical leads. You'll collaborate with researchers and our government customers to understand challenges, needs, and possible solutions.
* **Mentoring.**
  You'll contribute to improving the overall technical capabilities of the Division by mentoring and teaching others, participating in design (software and otherwise) sessions, and sharing insights and wisdom across the SEI.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Comprehensive knowledge of machine learning; previous experience in adversarial machine learning desirable but not required
* A track record of using well-established engineering practices to solve difficult problems
* An understanding of how to convert research results into functioning prototypes or capabilities
* Experience leading technical projects in novel areas with limited previous work to build upon
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to convey complex technical ideas in a layperson’s terms
* Ample experience with publishing written or technical artifacts showcasing your work
* Strong collaboration skills for working with colleagues and sponsors
* Willingness to guide and mentor junior team members

The AI Engineer designs, builds, deploys, and supports practical AI solutions that solve business problems and deliver measurable value. This role partners with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand workflows, identify high-value opportunities, and translate ambiguous needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions.

The position combines business-facing consulting with hands-on engineering, with a significant focus on designing, developing, integrating, testing, deploying, and supporting AI solutions. Solutions may range from low-code agents and automations to custom-developed Azure applications and integrations. The AI Engineer selects and implements the approach that best fits the business and technical requirements. The AI Engineer uses Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure, APIs, connectors, code, and other approved enterprise technologies, and treats AI solutions as production software by applying established software engineering and SDLC practices throughout their lifecycle.

Success requires both strong communication skills and sound engineering judgment. The ideal candidate can work comfortably with non-technical stakeholders while applying software engineering principles, AI governance, security, source control, testing, documentation, and operational support practices.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**
include but are not limited to:

* Supports and demonstrates IMA’s core values
* Values and understands the importance of diversity, equity, and inclusion among all IMA associates

Business Partnership & Solution Design

* Partner with the AI Enablement Lead and business stakeholders to understand problems, workflows, users, data dependencies, risks, and success criteria.
* Assess technical feasibility and translate business needs into requirements, solution architecture, user stories, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Communicate options, constraints, tradeoffs, and recommendations to business and technical audiences. The AI Enablement Lead primarily drives business engagement, prioritization, and adoption; the AI Engineer leads technical design and delivery.

AI Architecture & Engineering

* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain AI agents, copilots, workflow automations, integrations, and AI-enabled applications.
* Develop solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure services, APIs, connectors, Python and/or C#, and other approved technologies.
* Design integrations with enterprise applications, knowledge sources, and structured or unstructured data.
* Develop prompts, agent instructions, grounding strategies, tools, connectors, and reusable components.
* Apply RAG, semantic/vector search, embeddings, agentic patterns, and model orchestration when appropriate.
* Own or substantially contribute to architecture decisions, including Copilot Studio versus custom Azure solutions. Consider Azure AI Foundry capabilities when relevant and balance value, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability.

SDLC, Operations & Quality

* Apply SDLC practices across requirements, architecture, development, code review, testing, release management, documentation, support, and retirement.
* Use source control, CI/CD, environment separation, configuration management, and repeatable deployment practices.
* Implement appropriate unit, integration, functional, regression, security, and user-acceptance testing.
* Build in logging, monitoring, usage analytics, performance measures, and alerts; troubleshoot production issues and perform root-cause analysis.
* Create architecture diagrams, technical specifications, runbooks, support documentation, and user guidance.

Governance, Security & Value

* Implement controls for identity and access, data privacy, human oversight, source grounding, output validation, and auditability.
* Evaluate and mitigate hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe or inaccurate outputs, bias, data leakage, and inappropriate tool actions.
* Assess knowledge and data readiness, and partner with content owners to improve quality, permissions, organization, and lifecycle management.
* Partner with the AI Enablement Lead on pilots, rollout, user enablement, adoption, feedback, and measurement of business outcomes.
* Monitor solution reliability and usage, prioritize engineering enhancements, and contribute to the AI delivery backlog and roadmap.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS**
include but are not limited to:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Three or more years of experience in software engineering, application development, automation, AI solution delivery, or a related technical field
* At least one year of hands-on experience designing and implementing AI agents, copilots, workflow automations, or AI-enabled applications.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, and connectors, or experience with an equivalent platform.
* Experience developing or integrating Azure solutions, with working knowledge of identity, security, application hosting, data, integration, and monitoring services.
* Ability to develop, test, debug, and maintain production-quality applications, APIs, integrations, and automation using Python and/or C#, REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and data integration technologies.
* Experience applying SDLC practices and delivering solutions across business, technology, security, compliance, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including maintainability, testing, error handling, security, reliability, and documentation.
* Working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, grounding, RAG, agents, evaluations, and model limitations.
* Ability to design secure, scalable, observable, supportable, and cost-conscious cloud solutions.
* Understanding of authentication, authorization, secrets management, data protection, networking, APIs, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, presentation, and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with non-technical stakeholders.

**Job Description**
**Software Engineer**
**Monday-Friday 8:00-5:00**
**Remote**
CSC Corptax is the platform behind corporate tax for many of the largest enterprises in the world, handling provision, compliance, planning, and strategy all in the same solution. In addition to tax, we pioneer new solutions in the corporate software space.
  
  
We are looking for a software engineer to help us build the next generation of revolutionary tax preparation products.
  
  
The Team
  
  
We're a driven team that works test first, so quality belongs to everyone rather than to a separate function. Development is agent-led, using tools like Claude Code. However, we stand behind every line of code we ship.
  
  
Tech Stack
  
  
We choose tools to fit the problem, so the stack is flexible. Today it centers on Python, Node.js/TypeScript, C#/.Net, and React, running on cloud infrastructure with modern CI/CD. Experience with these specifically is a plus, but strong engineers who pick up new tools quickly are what matter most.
  
  
**Some of the things that you will be doing:**

* Design, build, and maintain core product systems across data ingestion, computation, user interfaces, and regulatory output.
* Own features end-to-end, from shaping requirements with the team through design, build, release, and iteration based on client feedback.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, and own the tests and tooling the team depends on.
* Work with systems where data security is of utmost priority.
* Turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable production code.
* Write and review design documents and take part in code reviews.
* Contribute to architecture decisions, technical standards, and engineering practices.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve performance, security, and reliability.
* Document systems and decisions so the team can move quickly and safely.

**What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field with at least 1-3 years of industry experience (equivalent practical experience will be considered as well).
* Have contributed to shipping production systems where you helped design, build, and maintain the solution.
* Proficiency in one or more modern languages, such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or C#/.Net.
* Experience with agent-led development tools, such as Claude Code.
* Experience with cloud platforms, APIs, relational databases, version control, and CI/CD.
* Quality tests written as you build, not as an afterthought.
* A product mindset: you care about whether what you build solves the user's problem, not only whether the code works.
* Comfort learning an unfamiliar, complex domain quickly and independently.
* Experience working alongside researchers or on problems without settled answers.
* Clear written and verbal communication.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with React or other modern frontend frameworks.
* Experience building data-dense interfaces for expert users.
* Experience with systems where correctness is audited or regulated.
* Experience with containerization, infrastructure as code, and observability tooling.
* Experience in an early-stage product or startup environment.
* Experience integrating with ERP, general ledger, or other financial systems.
* Background in tax, regulatory, legal, accounting, or another rule-governed domain.

**What You Get Out Of This**

* A funded product with real regulatory stakes.
* Ownership of meaningful parts of a product from early on.
* A small team that shares ownership of quality.
* Daily access to researchers, tax experts, and the world-class team behind the Corptax product suite.
* The budget and infrastructure to do the job properly.
* Fully remote in the U.S., with occasional on-site time or time-zone overlap as needed.

A Note from the Team
  
  
Corporate software is unforgiving. A wrong number is a real problem for a real client, so everything we ship must be correct and traceable. We need engineers who test by habit, own their work, and learn a challenging domain quickly. If that sounds like the team you want to join, go ahead and apply!
  
  
*Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.*

**Description**
Every year, Amazon's operations depend on hiring hundreds of thousands of hourly associates across the globe, and your work will determine how efficiently and effectively that happens. We are looking for a curious, resourceful Applied Scientist to tackle multi-objective optimization problems worldwide. In this role, you will build mathematical models and AI/ML systems that optimize recruitment processes under real-world cost, capacity, and regulatory constraints across North America and beyond. This is a particularly exciting time to join because we are expanding into new countries, building AI-native capabilities, and beginning to externalize our solutions so that teams beyond our own can benefit from the tools we create. You will partner with economists, machine learning engineers, and analytics engineers to turn theory-based decision models into production systems that improve candidate experience and business outcomes at a scale few teams can offer.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement optimization algorithms and mathematical models that determine optimal job posting timing, candidate management strategies, and recruitment coordination across multiple countries and markets.
* Develop and maintain conversion models, demand forecasting systems, and multi-objective optimization frameworks using machine learning, survival analysis, and causal inference techniques.
* Plan and run controlled experiments to validate new recruitment mechanisms, measure their impact, and iterate on model performance using real-world data.
* Write production-quality code in Python, applying optimal data structures and algorithms while making practical tradeoffs between complexity, memory efficiency, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with generation, hiring event, and coordination teams to integrate your models into automated hiring pipelines, and contribute to the team's scientific agenda through peer reviews, mentorship, and publications.

A day in the life
  
  
You might start your morning reviewing model performance dashboards and conversion metrics, then refine a stochastic dynamic programming model that balances hiring demand against cost constraints for an upcoming peak period. After lunch, you could be designing an A/B test for a new candidate management strategy or pairing with another scientist to incorporate local market regulations into an optimization framework. You will regularly present findings in science reviews and help shape the team's research roadmap.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team sits within Amazon's operations organization and owns the science behind converting job applicants into hired associates at a global scale. We support leadership teams across North America and beyond, building the optimization and ML systems that keep fulfillment centers staffed and ready to serve customers. Right now we are investing in AI-native automation, expanding our models to additional countries, and making our tools available to partner teams across the organization. The team is a multidisciplinary group of scientists, economists, machine learning engineers, and analytics engineers who collaborate closely to solve problems that span economic theory, statistical modeling, and large-scale engineering. We value rigorous experimentation, collaborative problem-solving, and a shared commitment to improving both business outcomes and the candidate experience.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
* Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
* Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms
* Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in professional software development
* Master's degree or above in econometrics, statistics, industrial engineering, operations research, optimization, data mining, analytics, or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment
